reusedReview.scope: Nine exact accepted A-E/H sources reused; current F/G and two oracle reinforcements are fresh judgments, not new full-file credit.

axes.A: VGA位复制TS近似与SDLPal差异沿原决定保留；day/night、默认cycles、借用cycles与短缓冲域不变。bitmap writer实际传PAT整chunk，省略cycles，当前source/DTO未改。
axes.B: 去R02/R07互指与“未占用”声明，保留位复制/夜半与非对称输入说明；helper的offset实为种子，改colorBlock(seed)避免字节单位误导。
axes.C: 三旧spec按纯decodePalette同一合同聚合，颜色/半块与cycles ownership两组；无IO/时钟/跨层状态，cycles来自caller不被parser生成。
axes.D: 两day/night例共用真正同域256×3输入builder，预期锚点手算而不调decode生成；不把短非法缓冲当正常PAT数据。
axes.E: 9身份保留；view继续核完整等价并新增独立RGB[4,12,20]/红通道146、长度及无夜色键。r恒0旧选中绿新唯一AssertionError，源/测试精确恢复；这些是锚点加完整关系，不冒称256项独立金标。
axes.F: palette.test与对应函数匹配，colors与cycles分组直接表达职责，bytes替代buf，seed不再冒充offset。
axes.G: 3旧文件归1，不增加helper层/模式布尔或skip；768 cycles值和1536借用/不突变是不同输入组合，不按相同配置字面量误删。
axes.H: 真实公开纯入口，fresh输入与借用cycles均可观察；指定业务反控支撑新增anchor，测试不mockcodec或私有字段。

processDisclosure: Nine input files regrouped into five outputs; palette.test.ts is intentionally retained in place with frozen before bytes and a separately checked current SHA. Old source absence is required only for paths not also current outputs.
29 old runtime identities retained; three BDF titles are clarified, two metamorphic cases receive independent oracles. No product policy, output format or asset pipeline changed.
Two selected mutant pairs old1green/new1AssertionError followed exact restoration. Full neighboring run follows restoration; skips in selected runs grant no regression credit.

Record proof first rejected two numeric bitmap constructor layouts, then a wrapped object assertion after role-name length changed. Exact bridges preserve guarded AST shapes and literal token order; first two exit1 raw reports remain. Grammar validation is a private helper, not a relaxed global whitespace or assertion rule.
